intro: Each guide is a short job: a product photo, a short ad, a launch clip, a last check, or clothing on a person. You use a photo of your own goods, write your own caption, and post without a shoot.
Choose a guide for your product, get its quick answer, then open the linked tool to make the photo or ad.

faq.q: Why start from a guide instead of a blank file?
faq.a: A guide gives you a simple starting point for the photo or ad. Add your product and message, then make the file in minutes.

faq.q: Can I put the downloaded file in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Your watermark-free download can be used in paid ads and client work. Use only product photos and brand assets you have permission to upload.
They are for shop owners and marketers making product photos or video ads. You can follow them without a studio or editing team.

faq.q: How do I use a guide to make a post?
faq.a: Follow the steps with your own product photo, then download the finished photo or video. You can publish it on your store or social channels.

faq.q: Why make a short ad instead of waiting on a creator?
faq.a: A short AI ad can be ready in minutes, without booking a creator. Change the opening message and make more versions for testing.

faq.q: How many credits does a photo or a clip cost?
faq.a: One photo costs 24 credits. Videos cost 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: How much does it cost to make content from a guide?
faq.a: Starter costs $24.50 for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600. A photo costs 24 credits; video credits depend on length.

faq.q: Can a beginner follow a guide?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a clear product photo and follow the steps. You do not need filming or editing experience.

faq.q: Are the faces in the clip real customers?
faq.a: No. AI actors are generated presenters, not customers who bought your product. Use them for ads without claiming they gave a real review.

faq.q: Which product marketing guide should I read first?
faq.a: Start with the guide for the photo or ad you need today. Each one shows a simple way to turn your product into content.

faq.q: Which platforms can I post the file to?
faq.a: Post the finished file on your store, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube. Choose a tall, square, or wide format for the placement.

faq.q: Can I start from photos I already shot?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear photo of the product you sell. You can build a new scene or video from it in minutes.

faq.q: Which products do the guides cover?
faq.a: The guides cover clothing, beauty, food, home goods, and electronics. The same steps can help with other products you sell.
